title: Industrial Nexus Manual
summary: Scale processing chains while watching heat, coolant, power, inputs, and diagnostic feedback.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Industrial Nexus turns raw survival into production. It asks you to think in chains: inputs, machines, heat, coolant, output storage, and diagnostic tools.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Build one small processing chain completely before making a factory. Confirm power, input rate, output room, and a way to respond when it stalls.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Gather materials, process them through machines, use byproducts, upgrade bottlenecks, and keep diagnostics nearby so failure is visible.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Thermal tools, factory diagnostics, flux meters, coolant packs, and recipe cards all help identify whether a problem is heat, power, recipe lock, or inventory flow.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: PowerGrid supplies stable energy, Logistics moves inputs and outputs, Index explains recipes, and MultiblockCore can host larger facility goals.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If production stops, check input, output, recipe, heat, power, and machine state in that order. Most factory problems are one missing constraint, not everything broken at once.
